mandatories.anchor: Ισχύουν οι οδηγίες brand των συνημμένων guidelines

open_questions.gap: No specific campaign messaging, brand positioning, or 'single-minded proposition' stated
open_questions.why_it_matters: Creative development requires clear messaging pillars to ensure consistency across channels and resonance with target audience
open_questions.suggested_question_for_client: Ποια είναι τα κύρια μηνύματα ή η 'single-minded proposition' που πρέπει να κεντρικά η καμπάνια για το Meltemi Fizz;

open_questions.gap: Video deliverables lack technical specification: quantity, duration, format, and intended distribution method not stated
open_questions.why_it_matters: Production planning and budget allocation require clear technical specifications to scope work appropriately
open_questions.suggested_question_for_client: Πόσα βίντεο αναμένετε και ποια θα ήταν η ιδανική διάρκειά τους (π.χ., τυπικό μήκος TikTok vs Instagram Reels vs YouTube);

open_questions.gap: Key visuals specification undefined: quantity, format, use cases, and application contexts not specified
open_questions.why_it_matters: Creative scope and production planning depend on understanding total deliverable volume and intended formats
open_questions.suggested_question_for_client: Πόσα key visuals θα χρειάζονται και που ακριβώς θα χρησιμοποιηθούν (social media, retail, OOH, packaging);

open_questions.gap: Budget breakdown unclear: €90,000 total includes media spend but allocation between production and paid media not specified
open_questions.why_it_matters: Agency resource planning and channel strategy depend on understanding how much budget is available for creative production versus paid media placement
open_questions.suggested_question_for_client: Πώς διαμερίζεται ο προϋπολογισμός των €90.000 μεταξύ δημιουργικής παραγωγής και media spend; Υπάρχει κονδύλιο για influencer partnerships ή seeding;

open_questions.gap: 'TikTok-first' strategy is stated but relationship to other required platforms unclear; prioritization ambiguous
open_questions.why_it_matters: Creative resource prioritization and channel budget allocation depend on whether TikTok dominates production, distribution, or both
open_questions.suggested_question_for_client: Όταν λέτε 'TikTok-first', αναφέρεστε σε προτεραιότητα κατανομής budget, παραγωγής creative, ή και των δύο; Πώς θα πρέπει τα creative assets να προσαρμοστούν για άλλα κανάλια;

open_questions.gap: Launch date stated but production timeline undefined: no milestones for concept approval, first draft review, or final delivery before launch date
open_questions.why_it_matters: Project scheduling and resource allocation require clear production milestones to ensure on-time delivery
open_questions.suggested_question_for_client: Ποιες είναι οι βασικές ημερομηνίες για υποβολή της πρότασης, την πρώτη έκδοση (concepto), τη τελική έγκριση και την παράδοση των deliverables πριν από το launch;

open_questions.gap: Brand guidelines referenced as 'συνημμένα' but not provided or accessed; guidelines appear incomplete or unavailable
open_questions.why_it_matters: Creative execution requires specific brand rules, visual standards, tone, and restrictions to ensure compliance
open_questions.suggested_question_for_client: Μπορείτε να μας υποβάλετε ή να μας δώσετε πρόσβαση στις ολοκληρωμένες brand guidelines (χρώματα, τυπογραφία, ήχος, περιορισμοί); Υπάρχουν προηγούμενα creative assets του Meltemi Fizz που θα πρέπει να ακολουθήσουμε;

open_questions.gap: Campaign success metrics and KPIs not stated; no measurable success criteria provided
open_questions.why_it_matters: Measurement strategy and success evaluation require pre-agreed KPIs aligned with business objectives
open_questions.suggested_question_for_client: Ποιοι είναι οι κύριοι KPI για το launch; Ποιό είναι το target reach, impressions, engagement rate ή conversion target; Υπάρχουν στόχοι πωλήσεων ή brand awareness shift που αναμένετε;

extraction_notes: Budget figure stated with Greek decimal notation (€90.000) representing 90,000 euros; no currency conversion applied.
RFP references 'συνημμένα guidelines' (attached guidelines) but attachment is not provided in source; recorded as stated without verification.
